digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and threshold configuration
propositions: Four code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must be flipped from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50) based on code-v3 corpus validation showing validity≥0.83 and precise low-volume impact.

The approved blocking-set governance tests must be updated from 3 members (secret-detection, high-critical-security, security) to 7 members to enforce deliberate re-approval for any future criterion additions.

Regression and error-handling are added as base-reviewer dimension entries where only default_posture, block_threshold, and blocking_enabled are consulted by registry.threshold_for; exec and applies_to fields remain inert.
This landing must precede RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) so that the immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden baseline incorporates these calibrated thresholds.
